items.title: Rockstar explains why GTA 6 has no prostitutes
items.summary: Rockstar told Shacknews it only kept features that fit the 'lovers on the run' story of Jason and Lucia, which is why hiring sex workers, a series staple since 2001, was cut.

items.title: The Web Is Dead In GTA 6: 'It Didn't Feel Necessary For Us'
items.summary: Rockstar's Rob Nelson explained that GTA 6 has no satirical websites because the team focused on social media and phone apps and on activities in the open world.

items.title: Please Enjoy These GTA 6 Clips Of Jason Petting, Fighting, And Being Eaten By Animals
items.summary: Players are sharing clips of GTA 6's detailed animal interactions, including petting dogs, a pet snake eating mice, and animals attacking Jason.

items.title: Rockstar says PS5 Pro can't handle GTA 6 at 60 FPS
items.summary: Rockstar technology production director Marc Chambers said the PS5 Pro's CPU isn't powerful enough for the game's simulation at higher frame rates, so a post-launch 60fps mode is unlikely.

items.title: Fake GTA 6 PC downloads are spreading malware through dark web scam bundle, NordVPN warns
items.summary: NordVPN found a $200 plug-and-play malware kit that uses a fake GTA 6 PC release as bait.

items.title: GTA 6 dev shares how Miami Vice, Heat, and Goodfellas are 'touchstones' for the game
items.summary: Rockstar narrative SVP Rupert Humphries told TechRadar how the team balanced Vice City's 80s nostalgia with a modern setting.

items.title: GTA 6 earns rave reviews and a 99 Metacritic score, tying for the highest-rated game of all time
items.summary: The review embargo lifted with near-universal perfect scores, and the game ties Ocarina of Time for the top Metacritic rating.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches in New Zealand to rave reviews, with over $1.5 billion in estimated pre-sales
items.summary: The staggered global rollout began with New Zealand at midnight local time, with Sensor Tower estimating about 16 million pre-orders.

items.title: GTA 6 review roundup live: critics give their verdict on the new Grand Theft Auto
items.summary: A live blog tracks the review scores, Rockstar's announced Miami festival on Nov. 21, and PC Gamer's 100-hour impressions.

items.title: PS5 gets last-minute system software update required to play GTA 6
items.summary: Sony announced a required PS5 system software update that players must install before the game unlocks, on top of the 602MB day-one patch.
